phase_c_notes.meaning: The mathematical affinity architecture A(v,a)=1[S(v)=S(v+e_a)≠0] survives. The failed G3 human procedure does not. A presentation-equivariant annotation path could in principle collect valid estimates of A, but that does NOT by itself open a connectome route without either (i) proving corrected labels are non-collinear / identifiable or (ii) obtaining instance GT S on target crops.
exact_presentation_fix_if_pursued: Show A and B co-marked on every docked plane that contains both voxels (including a mid-face plane for Z)
Park napari dims on the face midpoint or provide linked A/B Z slices for Z-edges
Use global (or matched) intensity normalization across docked planes
Axis-anonymous UI text during decision (reveal axis only after commit) OR randomized axis order
Pass synthetic six-permutation presentation suite before any human labels
